scope: The immutable first boss victory owns the original public spawn; ordinary accepted pickups remain owned by the existing latest-generation ground-item ledger. No fake player debit or new transaction collection is introduced.

A strong first-victory read and latest pickup-ledger read precede publication. An unavailable read is not treated as absence. Existing consumed, partial, reserved or expired custody is restored only through its actual latest record and saved owner receipt when complete.

Pickup lineage checks preserve the original item ID and affixes, position, party, birth, availability and expiry. Quantities may decrease but cannot inflate. Known item normalization accepts ordinary pickup serialization without stripping unknown future metadata.

Original-spawn replay is idempotent and preserves a newer local pickup reservation or generation fence if custody advanced after the earlier database read. Consumed loot is not resurrected, partial quantities are not refilled and expiry is not renewed.

A prepared schema22 active-drop index and bounded sorted primary/majority query include completed victories, not just pending private rewards. Startup drains active pages; a ten-record rotating recovery pass progresses past an unhealthy earlier prefix without scanning the full history per player action.

The existing bounded ground-projection capacity check is shared rather than replaced. Current ordinary one-minute boss loot and known payloads are supported; unsupported future payload/lifetime contracts are retained or refused, never silently rewritten.
